seal.statement: Work is accepted systemically, not locally (owner list 2026-10-04, items 4, 7, 8 and item 1's steering text). Item 4: an approving verification of a quest whose change set touches src/ is an approval only with a record (note --verification ... --evidence <record.json>, embedded in the entry) that names at least one verification template whose id is a front-matter category of a file in docs/development/verification-templates (no retyped list), carries per named template its red-on-revert (reverted path in the quest's src/ change, what was reverted, the witness file - existing and in the change set or the quest's receipts - the behavioural assertion, and evidence by plain path or path:line that exists and names that assertion), carries every field the template's front-matter evidence list demands (whatChanged for retry-loops and sweep-timer), names every template whose trigger matches the change's added src/ lines, and carries a sample of the author's census and history pass or a locality proof with its census file; land refuses otherwise naming exactly what is missing, note refuses an unknown template id, and a quest touching no src/ path keeps today's behaviour. v1 enforced this through solver-verifier-verdict/1 (scripts/solve/verifier-verdict.js at 5271defb5^), lost in the v2 cutover. Item 7: the closure ledger gains mechanism classes MC-001..MC-004 (proxy signal, removal by key after an await, capture-then-wait, optimistic credit for work in flight) in the record form, and its --check-state audit holds them to the record checks plus definition, detection question and resolving commit, quest and path references; the design-note template and the quest guidance each point at the class list in one line. Item 8: AGENTS.md tells the receiver of a handoff that a claim naming no exact commit and suites is unproven. Item 1 (steering only): R04's body says a wait that reaches its bound is such a failure, logged with what was awaited and the last observed state, never an outcome or a normal exit. The always-loaded steering stays at 360 lines.

text: History pass. v1 enforced a verifier verdict file, solver-verifier-verdict/1 (scripts/solve/verifier-verdict.js at 5271defb5^, landed by 166b4d404): strict keys, completedTemplateItems [{category, evidencePaths}] accounted exactly against requiredReviewTemplates (review-request.js:272, derived from the templates' front-matter categories plus keyword suggestions in verification-template-suggest.js, advisory), every evidence path a bounded non-empty workspace file hashed into the receipt, rejections needing category-complete defect findings. 5271defb5 (solve-v2 phase 2 cutover) deleted all three files; v2 note --verification records free text + verifier + verdict and land's verdictState reads only the verdict. Restored here: the template accounting (ids from the same front-matter categories, no retyped list), per-template evidence (now the red-on-revert, plus fields a template declares in front-matter), evidence paths that must exist. Not restored: exact template accounting against a mechanically required set (v1 suggestions were advisory; here a template's own front-matter trigger makes it required), the reviewId binding, rejection findings shape, file hashing.

Consumer census of the 'current approving verification' predicate on d60c30921: (1) commands.js land -> verificationProblems(state, paths) (verdictState over store.questState); (2) store.verdictOf/questState also classify migrated v1 entries (finding kinds verified/rejected), so a legacy approval is an approval through isApproval and needs a record too (bootstrap: in-flight quests re-verify); (3) sibling quest src-changes-land-through-the-solver (a6c8da040) moves verificationProblems into guards.js and calls it from land AND from the main admission (recordedLogProblem over the log a landing commit carries, governingQuestProblem for a merge). No other reader (grep verdictOf|lastVerification|verificationIsCurrent over scripts/: store.js, commands.js, migrate-v1.js classification only). Decision (lead direction 2026-10-04): the record check is ONE pure function verificationRecordProblems(logEntries, changeSet{paths, addedSourceLines}, tree{read, list}) so admission can call it over the commit (tree = git blobs at the commit, changeSet = the commit's diff); every file it names must be a path in that tree (a quest log line included), never a scratch path. land calls it with workingTreeReader/workingChangeSet. Hook-up for admit is one call inside the sibling's recordedLogProblem once it lands.

Item 7 shape: the ledger had no class concept (closure-grammar failureClass is a 7-value taxonomy field on incident records, the audit checks only STATE presence and index drift). Attempt 2 (verifier residuals on 1afc18ee7, subagent:vbc-review-1): (1) cheap fakes refused - evidence may be neither the witness nor a production-surface file, a quest-log citation must name an evidence finding recorded before the verification (entry order in the own log, timestamp in another quest's), a whole quest log is not a citation, an empty cited line is no line, and the witness may not be production code; (2) the template catalog fails closed on an id declared by two files (naming both) and on an invalid trigger (typed refusal naming the file); (3) triggers match code constructs only (comment lines, string literals and trailing comments removed; sweep-timer = setTimeout(/setInterval(/AbortSignal.timeout/Promise.race/*_MS deadline identifiers/timeoutMs/deadlineMs; retry-loops = retry/backoff/redrive/requeue/rearm in code) and a demanded field answered n/a/none/-/blank is refused; (4) a class commit must be an ancestor of the audited HEAD, MC-002 cites 7e0c039d7; (5) witnesses for whitespace-only fields and for the '..' tree-path guard; (6) guards.js reads front matter through store.parseFrontMatter (inline lists added there), last_reviewed bumped; (7) one local production surface (src/, vendor/) in scripts/solve/guards.js for the rebase to delete; (8) the check takes full ls-tree paths and a commit-built change set, witnessed on a commit and a merge; test/solve/verification-record-fixture.js exports completeRecord for the sibling's fixtures.

Admission hook-up contract (mechanical, for the rebase onto src-changes-land-through-the-solver; the main admission reads a commit, never the working tree). Call verificationRecordProblems(log, changeSet, tree) from scripts/solve/guards.js beside approvalProblems wherever the admission judges a landing commit's recorded log (recordedLogProblem, reached from terminalBindingProblem and governingQuestProblem), joining its problems to approvalProblems'. Inputs: (1) log = the quest's log.ndjson parsed from the commit (gitBlob(root, commit, solve/quests/<id>/log.ndjson), as governingQuestProblem already reads it). (2) tree = {read: (p) => the blob text of p at the commit or null, list: (dir) => lines(git ls-tree --name-only <commit> <dir>/)} - FULL repository paths, the shape workingTreeReader answers for land. (3) changeSet = {paths: every path of git diff --name-only <parent> <commit> (all paths, not only the production ones: the witness, a test file, is bound by being in the change set or the receipts), addedSourceLines: the '+' lines (without '+++' headers, leading '+' stripped) of git diff --no-color --unified=0 <parent> <commit> -- src vendor}; parent = row.parents[0] or the empty tree for a single-parent landing; for a Quest-trailer merge parent = the first parent and paths = the merge's real paths (mergeSourcePaths for the production part plus the non-production paths it changes against the first parent), never the literal [...PRODUCTION_SURFACE]: with a literal no reverted path is ever in the change set and every merge-governed quest is refused. Witnessed by test/solve/commands.test.js 'the record check judges a commit and a merge over src/ and vendor/' (commitTree/judgeCommit there are the reference adapter). (4) Delete the two statements PRODUCTION_SURFACE_LOCAL and the local isProductionPath after PATH_SEGMENT_SEPARATOR in scripts/solve/guards.js and use the sibling's isProductionPath (same semantics: src, vendor, the directory itself included). (5) The sibling's landedSourceQuest test helper lands a production change on a bare approve; after the rebase seed its repo with writeVerificationTemplates(root) and approve through verify(root, questId, completeRecord(root, questId, {reverted, witness, assertion})) from test/solve/verification-record-fixture.js.

Open gap, for the lead/owner (verifier-noted, confirmed on the combined tree with a scratch test, not committed): a production path added AFTER the approval, with no new attempt and no template trigger firing, still lands and is admitted - land landed {src/thing.js, src/added-after-approval.js} on a record whose red-on-revert names only src/thing.js, and admit exited 0. A's binding does not close it: the terminal's source digest is computed by land at landing time from the index it commits, so it binds the commit to the terminal entry, not the approval to the change it reviewed; currency is attempt-ordered only. Closing it soundly is more than a few lines and changes the verification workflow, so it is not built here: the approving verification records the source digest of the production change it reviewed (note --verification --verdict approve stamps sourceChangeRecord of the would-be landing - the working tree's production surface through a temporary index, since land stages only after its checks), approvalProblems refuses when that digest differs from the change being landed (land: the same temporary-index digest; admit: the landing commit's sourceChangeRecord, equal to the terminal's source), and the runbook says any production edit after a verdict needs a new attempt and verdict. Consequences to decide: every lead tidy after an approval needs re-verification; witnesses that approve before writing their last src/ byte must be reordered. Until then the control is the attempt rule plus the verifier naming the exact tree it reviewed.
